meta.name: type:viz_szamla

changelog.note: Silent content errors: distinct_parties role-pair check(s) supplier_name/customer_name; a to-do at the second field when both name one party (jav/fact_checks.py). Extraction requests are unchanged.

Decision of 2026-09-28: vat_consistency (net + VAT = gross) only a mark (review: false) - the summary's cover sheet has no net and VAT, so it opened a to-do on every document of a measurement; the items' sum check still opens a to-do

Invoice line items - the line_items list with the GPT schema's item fields (the prompt and the schema unchanged, the extraction costs no more); line item checks in code: line_items_total (the items' sum = the total) and line_items_arithmetic (per row quantity × unit price ≈ net, net × (1 + VAT rate) ≈ gross); the per-row arithmetic is only a mark here (review: false, decision of 2026-09-28): a recurring, pro rata monthly fee item's unit price does not refer to the quantity, so it would mark every one of the 10 stored results

Parent and the legacy detect.json's keywords for choosing the detailed type (source: 10_AIFLOW_V4/flows/doc-extract-bare/types/viz_szamla/detect.json, sha256 7f3e0b378188ec21); the extraction unchanged

Type pack: the bill collector's 'Terhelesi osszesito', a payment summary bundle's cover sheet (the legacy project calls it viz_szamla) - extends utility_bill_hu; the child fields in the legacy schema.json's order (service_provider: name; collector_id, payment_reference, meter_serial, tariff, reading_method: text; consumption_m3 and the meter readings: number); vat_consistency (legacy rules.json); not scored: meter_serial, payment_reference, collector_id; the legacy golden set scores the COVER SHEET's level (9 fields: issuer, customer, summary number, dates, payment method, currency, amount due = gross); the prompt and the schema verbatim
